title: Hydroxysafflor Yellow A modulation of metabolite networks and inhibition of JAK2/STAT1 pathway in sepsis.
authors: Pan, Bingbing; Chen, Fengting; Shen, Siyan; Jiang, Yu; Yang, Ying; Wang, Jia; Liu, Yanjuan; Wei, Lai; Liu, Jitong; Kong, Gaoyin; He, Xuan; Guo, Bing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HYSA对脓毒症的保护作用，涉及代谢组学和JAK2/STAT1通路，但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sepsis, a severe infectious disease causing multiple organ dysfunction, requires further exploration of its pathomechanisms and therapeutic options. Hydroxysafflor Yellow A (HYSA), extracted from Carthamus tinctorius L, has shown anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties effective in treating sepsis, though its precise mechanism remains unclear. In this study, a cecum ligation puncture (CLP) model was used to evaluate HYSA's effects on sepsis-induced organ injury. HYSA (300 mg/kg) was administered intraperitoneally 4 h post-CLP. Results showed that HYSA inhibited the inflammatory response and improved pathological scores in the liver, lungs, and kidneys. Metabolomics analysis identified key metabolites and pathways influenced by HYSA, including nicotinate and nicotinamide metabolism and glycine/serine metabolism. Network pharmacology and molecular docking identified JAK2/STAT1 as potential targets, with Western blotting confirmed that HYSA inhibits JAK2/STAT1 phosphorylation. These findings suggest that HYSA protects against sepsis-induced organ injury by regulating metabolic networks and modulating the JAK2/STAT1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 脓毒症是一种导致多器官功能障碍的严重感染性疾病，需要进一步探索其病理机制和治疗选择。从红花（Carthamus tinctorius L）中提取的羟基红花黄色素A（HYSA）已显示出抗炎和抗氧化特性，在治疗脓毒症方面有效，但其确切机制尚不清楚。本研究采用盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）模型评估HYSA对脓毒症诱导的器官损伤的影响。在CLP后4小时腹腔注射HYSA（300 mg/kg）。结果表明，HYSA抑制了炎症反应，并改善了肝脏、肺和肾脏的病理评分。代谢组学分析确定了受HYSA影响的关键代谢物和通路，包括烟酸和烟酰胺代谢以及甘氨酸/丝氨酸代谢。网络药理学和分子对接将JAK2/STAT1确定为潜在靶点，Western blotting证实HYSA抑制JAK2/STAT1磷酸化。这些发现表明，HYSA通过调节代谢网络和调控JAK2/STAT1通路，对脓毒症诱导的器官损伤具有保护作用。
